sources.summary: What happens when architecture is asked to create a room without boundaries? Convention halls , stadiums , factories , and logistics centers all begin with the same architectural challenge: creating large, uninterrupted interiors that can accommodate movement, visibility, and changing uses. The larger the span, the greater the structural demands, and the greater the architectural possibilities.
